create_bleu_scorer: create a BleuScorer instance to compute BLEU scores for translation evaluation
build_bleu_score: build BLEU scores by passing test sentences and reference sentences to BleuScorer.compute_score
test_cook_refs: test cook_refs function to transform reference sentences into BLEU-compatible form
review_cook_test: review cook_test function to transform test sentences with cooked references into BLEU metrics
summarize_bleu_scorer: summarize BleuScorer class methods for incremental BLEU score computation across sentences
